arguments.query: "HBM brings smiles to foundries" Samsung September 22 2026 ...

queries: "HBM brings smiles to foundries" Samsung September 22 2026
Samsung 4nm capacity HBM4 base die MoneyToday September 22 2026 independent report
Samsung HBM4 base die 4nm capacity expand HBM4E September 2026 news
site:news.samsung.com HBM4 base die 4nm mass production 2026

content.text:
Samsung allocates more than half of 4nm foundry capacity to HBM4: The dated page headline and visible lead say more than half of Samsung’s 4nm foundry capacity was allocated to HBM4 base dies. The article body is paywalled, limiting verification of its underlying sourcing and detail. (time=2026-09-08T11:56:00; cutoff=BEFORE_CUTOFF).
HBM에 웃는 파운드리… 삼성, 4나노 증설 채비: MoneyToday reports that Samsung’s 4nm lines were fully utilized, that it was reviewing expansion to meet HBM4 base-die demand, and that over half of current 4nm capacity was reportedly assigned to HBM4 base dies. It also reports a possible 2nm line for HBM5 and a company forecast for HBM4 revenue growth; these are reports or forecasts, not realized outcomes. (time=2026-09-22T04:00:00+09:00; cutoff=BEFORE_CUTOFF).
Samsung Ships Industry-First Commercial HBM4 With Ultimate Performance for AI Computing: Samsung said HBM4 mass production and commercial shipments had begun, described its 4nm logic base die, and said it was expanding HBM4 capacity. The company also forecast 2026 HBM sales above 2025 levels. The release does not quantify a 4nm allocation share or confirm the later reported expansion review. (time=2026-02-12; cutoff=BEFORE_CUTOFF).
Samsung Locks In HBM4 Yields, Prepares Volume Push: The article reports, based on industry sources, Samsung HBM4 yield improving to around 80% from below 60% early in mass production. It reports projected monthly HBM wafer input rising from about 180,000 in 2026 to 250,000 in 2027, while noting HBM4E mass-production timing could vary with customer certification and demand. These are reported estimates and projections, not issuer-confirmed realized output. (time=2026-09-20T18:01:34+09:00; cutoff=BEFORE_CUTOFF).
